int locate(string needle, string[] values)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#values)
        if needle == values[k]
            return k
    return -1

int integer_value(string value)
    return int(value)

bool has(int needle, int[] values)
    for value := values[]
        if needle == value
            return true
    return false

string cabin_name(int cabin)
    return ["F", "J", "Y"][cabin]

class Seat(string label, int row, int cabin, int block, int offset, string kind, bool exit_row, bool blocked)
class Cabin(int cabin, int first, int last, string[] blocks)
class Aircraft(string model, int base, int limit, Cabin[] cabins, Seat[] seats)
class Flight(string name, int aircraft, int[] limits, bool[] blocked, int[] occupied, bool closed, int[] volunteers)
class Booking(string pnr, int flight, bool checked, int[] people)
class Passenger(string name, int category, string preference, int booking, int cabin, int seat, int partner, bool alive)
class State()
    Aircraft[] aircraft := []
    Flight[] flights := []
    Booking[] bookings := []
    Passenger[] passengers := []
    string[] tier_names := []
    int[] tiers := []
    pending := Aircraft("", 0, 0, [], [])

int flight_id(const State state, string name)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.flights)
        if state.flights[k].name == name
            return k
    return -1

int remaining_count(const State state, int booking)
    count := 0
    for person := state.bookings[booking].people[]
        if state.passengers[person].alive
            count += 1
    return count

int booking_id(const State state, string pnr, include_empty := false)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.bookings)
        if state.bookings[k].pnr == pnr and (include_empty or remaining_count(state, k) > 0)
            return k
    return -1

int person_id(const State state, int booking, string name)
    for person := state.bookings[booking].people[]
        if state.passengers[person].alive and state.passengers[person].name == name
            return person
    return -1

int[] people_of(const State state, int flight)
    return [for k := (0:<int(#state.passengers))[] if state.passengers[k].alive and state.bookings[state.passengers[k].booking].flight == flight then k]

int tier_of(const State state, string name)
    k := locate(name, state.tier_names)
    return if k < 0 then 3 else state.tiers[k]

int cabin_id(const Aircraft plane, int cabin)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#plane.cabins)
        if plane.cabins[k].cabin == cabin
            return k
    return -1

int seat_id(const Aircraft plane, string label)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#plane.seats)
        if plane.seats[k].label == label
            return k
    return -1

bool with_infant(const State state, int person)
    return state.passengers[person].category == 0 and state.passengers[person].partner >= 0

int booked_count(const State state, int flight, int cabin)
    result := 0
    for person := people_of(state, flight)[]
        if state.passengers[person].category != 2 and state.passengers[person].cabin == cabin
            result += 1
    return result

bool permitted(const State state, int flight, int person, int seat, int cabin, int[] ignored)
    trip := state.flights[flight]
    target := state.aircraft[trip.aircraft].seats[seat]
    if target.cabin != cabin or trip.blocked[seat]
        return false
    if trip.occupied[seat] >= 0 and not has(trip.occupied[seat], ignored)
        return false
    if target.exit_row and (state.passengers[person].category == 1 or with_infant(state, person))
        return false
    if with_infant(state, person)
        plane := state.aircraft[trip.aircraft]
        for: 0 <= k < int(#plane.seats)
            other := plane.seats[k]
            occupant := trip.occupied[k]
            if other.row == target.row and other.block == target.block and occupant >= 0 and not has(occupant, ignored)
                if with_infant(state, occupant)
                    return false
    return true

bool fits(const State state, int flight, int[] people, int[] seats)
    plane := state.aircraft[state.flights[flight].aircraft]
    for: 0 <= k < int(#people)
        if seats[k] < 0 or not permitted(state, flight, people[k], seats[k], state.passengers[people[k]].cabin, people)
            return false
        for: 0 <= j < k
            if seats[j] == seats[k]
                return false
            if with_infant(state, people[k]) and with_infant(state, people[j])
                if plane.seats[seats[k]].row == plane.seats[seats[j]].row and plane.seats[seats[k]].block == plane.seats[seats[j]].block
                    return false
    return true

int choose(const State state, int flight, int person, int cabin)
    plane := state.aircraft[state.flights[flight].aircraft]
    first := -1
    for: 0 <= k < int(#plane.seats)
        if permitted(state, flight, person, k, cabin, [person])
            if first < 0
                first = k
            if state.passengers[person].preference != "" and plane.seats[k].kind == state.passengers[person].preference
                return k
    return first

void place(State &state, int person, int seat)
    flight := state.bookings[state.passengers[person].booking].flight
    old := state.passengers[person].seat
    if old >= 0
        state.flights[flight].occupied[old] = -1
    state.passengers[person].seat = seat
    if seat >= 0
        state.flights[flight].occupied[seat] = person

string seat_text(const State state, int person)
    passenger := state.passengers[person]
    if passenger.category == 2
        return "LAP"
    flight := state.bookings[passenger.booking].flight
    return if passenger.seat < 0 then "UNASSIGNED" else state.aircraft[state.flights[flight].aircraft].seats[passenger.seat].label

string[] reassign(State &state, int flight)
    string[] output := []
    for person := people_of(state, flight)[]
        passenger := state.passengers[person]
        if passenger.category != 2 and passenger.seat < 0
            seat := choose(state, flight, person, passenger.cabin)
            if seat >= 0
                place(&state, person, seat)
                output = output.append("REASSIGNED " + state.bookings[passenger.booking].pnr + " " + passenger.name + " " + seat_text(state, person))
    return output

void remove_person(State &state, int person)
    if not state.passengers[person].alive
        return
    partner := state.passengers[person].partner
    flight := state.bookings[state.passengers[person].booking].flight
    if state.passengers[person].category == 0 and partner >= 0
        remove_person(&state, partner)
    elif state.passengers[person].category == 2 and partner >= 0
        state.passengers[partner].partner = -1
    place(&state, person, -1)
    state.passengers[person].alive = false
    state.passengers[person].partner = -1
    state.flights[flight].volunteers = [for volunteer := state.flights[flight].volunteers[] if volunteer != person then volunteer]

int[] row_seats(const Aircraft plane, int row, block := -1)
    return [for k := (0:<int(#plane.seats))[] if plane.seats[k].row == row and (block < 0 or plane.seats[k].block == block) then k]

string assign_group(State &state, int flight, int cabin, int[] people)
    count := int(#people)
    if count == 1
        place(&state, people[0], choose(state, flight, people[0], cabin))
        return "SINGLE"
    plane := state.aircraft[state.flights[flight].aircraft]
    section := plane.cabins[cabin_id(plane, cabin)]
    for: 0 <= stage < 3
        first_height := if stage == 2 then 2 else 1
        last_height := if stage == 2 then count else 1
        for: first_height <= height <= last_height
            width := if stage == 2 then (count + height - 1) / height else count
            for: section.first <= row <= section.last
                block_count := if stage == 1 then 1 else int(#section.blocks)
                for: 0 <= block < block_count
                    seats := row_seats(plane, row, if stage == 1 then -1 else block)
                    for: 0 <= start <= int(#seats) - width
                        int[] candidate := []
                        if stage < 2
                            candidate = seats[start:<start + count]
                        else
                            for: 0 <= k < count
                                next_row := row + k / width
                                next_seats := row_seats(plane, next_row, block)
                                if next_row > section.last or int(#next_seats) < start + width
                                    candidate = []
                                    break
                                candidate = candidate.append(next_seats[start + k % width])
                        if #candidate == #people and fits(state, flight, people, candidate)
                            for: 0 <= k < count
                                place(&state, people[k], candidate[k])
                            return ["BLOCK", "ROW", "STACK"][stage]
    for person := people[]
        place(&state, person, choose(state, flight, person, cabin))
    return "SPLIT"

string closed_error(const State state, int flight)
    return "ERROR flight " + state.flights[flight].name + " is closed"

string passenger_error(const State state, string pnr, string name)
    booking := booking_id(state, pnr)
    if booking < 0
        return "ERROR unknown PNR " + pnr
    if state.flights[state.bookings[booking].flight].closed
        return closed_error(state, state.bookings[booking].flight)
    if person_id(state, booking, name) < 0
        return "ERROR no passenger " + name + " in " + pnr
    return ""

bool lex_before(int[] a, int[] b)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#a)
        if a[k] != b[k]
            return a[k] < b[k]
    return false

string load_factor(int seated, int seats)
    q := seated * 1000 / seats
    return "{q / 10}.{q % 10}%"

string[] execute(string input_line, State &state)
    fields := input_line.split(" ")
    command := fields[0]
    if command == "AIRCRAFT"
        state.pending = Aircraft(fields[1], integer_value(fields[2]), integer_value(fields[3]), [], [])
        return []
    if command == "CABIN"
        cabin := locate(fields[1], ["F", "J", "Y"])
        first := integer_value(fields[2])
        last := integer_value(fields[3])
        blocks := fields[4:]
        state.pending.cabins = state.pending.cabins.append(Cabin(cabin, first, last, blocks))
        for: first <= row <= last
            for: 0 <= block < int(#blocks)
                for: 0 <= offset < int(#blocks[block])
                    window := (block == 0 and offset == 0) or (block == int(#blocks) - 1 and offset == int(#blocks[block]) - 1)
                    kind := if window then "W" elif offset == 0 or offset == int(#blocks[block]) - 1 then "A" else "M"
                    label := string(row) + blocks[block][offset]
                    state.pending.seats = state.pending.seats.append(Seat(label, row, cabin, block, offset, kind, false, false))
        return []
    if command == "EXIT"
        for: 1 <= k < int(#fields)
            row := integer_value(fields[k])
            for: 0 <= j < int(#state.pending.seats)
                if state.pending.seats[j].row == row
                    state.pending.seats[j].exit_row = true
        return []
    if command == "BLOCKED"
        for: 1 <= k < int(#fields)
            state.pending.seats[seat_id(state.pending, fields[k])].blocked = true
        return []
    if command == "END"
        string result := "AIRCRAFT " + state.pending.model
        for section := state.pending.cabins[]
            count := 0
            for seat := state.pending.seats[]
                if seat.cabin == section.cabin and not seat.blocked
                    count += 1
            result += " " + cabin_name(section.cabin) + " " + string(count)
        state.aircraft = state.aircraft.append(state.pending)
        return [result]
    if command == "STATUS"
        tier := locate(fields[2], ["PLATINUM", "GOLD", "SILVER", "NONE"])
        k := locate(fields[1], state.tier_names)
        if k < 0
            state.tier_names = state.tier_names.append(fields[1])
            state.tiers = state.tiers.append(tier)
        else
            state.tiers[k] = tier
        return ["STATUS " + fields[1] + " " + fields[2]]
    if command == "FLIGHT"
        if flight_id(state, fields[1]) >= 0
            return ["ERROR duplicate flight " + fields[1]]
        model := -1
        for: 0 <= k < int(#state.aircraft)
            if state.aircraft[k].model == fields[2]
                model = k
        if model < 0
            return ["ERROR unknown aircraft " + fields[2]]
        plane := state.aircraft[model]
        overbook := integer_value(fields[3])
        limits := [0, 0, 0]
        blocked := [for seat := plane.seats[] then seat.blocked]
        occupied := array(#plane.seats, fill = -1)
        result := "FLIGHT " + fields[1] + " " + fields[2]
        for section := plane.cabins[]
            count := 0
            for seat := plane.seats[]
                if seat.cabin == section.cabin and not seat.blocked
                    count += 1
            limits[section.cabin] = count * (100 + overbook) / 100
            result += " " + cabin_name(section.cabin) + " " + string(count) + "/" + string(limits[section.cabin])
        state.flights = state.flights.append(Flight(fields[1], model, limits, blocked, occupied, false, []))
        return [result]
    if command == "BOOK"
        pnr := fields[1]
        if booking_id(state, pnr, true) >= 0
            return ["ERROR duplicate PNR " + pnr]
        flight := flight_id(state, fields[2])
        if flight < 0
            return ["ERROR unknown flight " + fields[2]]
        if state.flights[flight].closed
            return [closed_error(state, flight)]
        cabin := locate(fields[3], ["F", "J", "Y"])
        plane := state.aircraft[state.flights[flight].aircraft]
        if cabin_id(plane, cabin) < 0
            return ["ERROR no cabin " + fields[3] + " on " + fields[2]]
        string[] names := []
        int[] types := []
        string[] preferences := []
        for: 4 <= k < int(#fields)
            part := fields[k].split(":")
            if locate(part[0], names) >= 0
                return ["ERROR duplicate name " + part[0] + " in " + pnr]
            names = names.append(part[0])
            types = types.append(locate(part[1], ["ADULT", "CHILD", "INFANT"]))
            preferences = preferences.append(if #part == 3 then part[2] else "")
        for name := names[]
            for person := people_of(state, flight)[]
                if state.passengers[person].name == name
                    return ["ERROR " + name + " already on " + fields[2]]
        adults := 0
        infants := 0
        for category := types[]
            if category == 0
                adults += 1
            elif category == 2
                infants += 1
        if adults == 0
            return ["ERROR no adult in " + pnr]
        if infants > adults
            return ["ERROR too many infants in " + pnr]
        needed := int(#names) - infants
        if booked_count(state, flight, cabin) + needed > state.flights[flight].limits[cabin]
            return ["ERROR limit exceeded for " + fields[2] + " " + fields[3]]
        booking := int(#state.bookings)
        int[] people := []
        int[] seated_people := []
        int[] adult_ids := []
        int[] infant_ids := []
        for: 0 <= k < int(#names)
            person := int(#state.passengers)
            people = people.append(person)
            state.passengers = state.passengers.append(Passenger(names[k], types[k], preferences[k], booking, cabin, -1, -1, true))
            if types[k] == 2
                infant_ids = infant_ids.append(person)
            else
                seated_people = seated_people.append(person)
                if types[k] == 0
                    adult_ids = adult_ids.append(person)
        state.bookings = state.bookings.append(Booking(pnr, flight, false, people))
        for: 0 <= k < infants
            state.passengers[adult_ids[k]].partner = infant_ids[k]
            state.passengers[infant_ids[k]].partner = adult_ids[k]
        method := assign_group(&state, flight, cabin, seated_people)
        result := "BOOKED " + pnr + " " + fields[2] + " " + fields[3] + " " + method
        for person := people[]
            result += " " + state.passengers[person].name + ":" + seat_text(state, person)
        return [result]
    if command == "FIND"
        string[] output := []
        for: 0 <= flight < int(#state.flights)
            for person := people_of(state, flight)[]
                passenger := state.passengers[person]
                if passenger.name == fields[1]
                    output = output.append(state.flights[flight].name + " " + state.bookings[passenger.booking].pnr + " " + cabin_name(passenger.cabin) + " " + seat_text(state, person) + (if state.flights[flight].closed then " CLOSED" else " OPEN"))
        tier := ["PLATINUM", "GOLD", "SILVER", "NONE"][tier_of(state, fields[1])]
        return ["FIND " + fields[1] + " " + tier + " " + string(#output)].concat(output)
    if command == "SEAT" or command == "SWAP" or command == "CANCEL" or command == "CHECKIN" or command == "VOLUNTEER" or command == "INFO"
        booking := booking_id(state, fields[1])
        if booking < 0
            return ["ERROR unknown PNR " + fields[1]]
        flight := state.bookings[booking].flight
        if command != "INFO" and state.flights[flight].closed
            return [closed_error(state, flight)]
        if command == "INFO"
            output := ["INFO " + fields[1] + " " + state.flights[flight].name + " " + string(remaining_count(state, booking)) + (if state.bookings[booking].checked then " CHECKED" else " NOT-CHECKED")]
            for person := state.bookings[booking].people[]
                if state.passengers[person].alive
                    passenger := state.passengers[person]
                    output = output.append(passenger.name + " " + ["ADULT", "CHILD", "INFANT"][passenger.category] + " " + cabin_name(passenger.cabin) + " " + seat_text(state, person))
            return output
        if command == "CHECKIN"
            if state.bookings[booking].checked
                return ["ERROR " + fields[1] + " already checked in"]
            state.bookings[booking].checked = true
            return ["CHECKIN " + fields[1] + " " + string(remaining_count(state, booking))]
        person := if #fields > 2 then person_id(state, booking, fields[2]) else -1
        if (command != "CANCEL" or #fields == 3) and person < 0
            return ["ERROR no passenger " + fields[2] + " in " + fields[1]]
        if command == "CANCEL"
            int[] targets := []
            adults := 0
            remaining := 0
            for member := state.bookings[booking].people[]
                if not state.passengers[member].alive
                    continue
                target := #fields == 2 or member == person or (person >= 0 and with_infant(state, person) and member == state.passengers[person].partner)
                if target
                    targets = targets.append(member)
                else
                    remaining += 1
                    if state.passengers[member].category == 0
                        adults += 1
            if remaining > 0 and adults == 0
                return ["ERROR " + fields[1] + " would have no adult"]
            result := "CANCELLED " + fields[1]
            for target := targets[]
                result += " " + state.passengers[target].name
                remove_person(&state, target)
            return [result].concat(reassign(&state, flight))
        passenger := state.passengers[person]
        if command == "SWAP"
            problem := passenger_error(state, fields[3], fields[4])
            if problem != ""
                return [problem]
            other_booking := booking_id(state, fields[3])
            other := person_id(state, other_booking, fields[4])
            if person == other
                return ["ERROR cannot swap " + fields[2] + " with itself"]
            for target := [person, other][]
                if state.passengers[target].category == 2
                    return ["ERROR infant " + state.passengers[target].name + " has no seat"]
            if state.bookings[other_booking].flight != flight
                return ["ERROR " + fields[1] + " and " + fields[3] + " are on different flights"]
            if passenger.cabin != state.passengers[other].cabin
                return ["ERROR " + fields[2] + " and " + fields[4] + " are in different cabins"]
            for target := [person, other][]
                if state.passengers[target].seat < 0
                    return ["ERROR " + state.passengers[target].name + " has no seat"]
            first_seat := passenger.seat
            second_seat := state.passengers[other].seat
            if not fits(state, flight, [person, other], [second_seat, first_seat])
                return ["ERROR swap of " + fields[2] + " and " + fields[4] + " breaks seating rules"]
            place(&state, person, -1)
            place(&state, other, -1)
            place(&state, person, second_seat)
            place(&state, other, first_seat)
            return ["SWAPPED " + fields[1] + " " + fields[2] + " " + seat_text(state, person) + " " + fields[3] + " " + fields[4] + " " + seat_text(state, other)].concat(reassign(&state, flight))
        if command == "VOLUNTEER"
            if passenger.category != 0 or with_infant(state, person)
                return ["ERROR " + fields[2] + " cannot volunteer"]
            if passenger.seat < 0
                return ["ERROR " + fields[2] + " has no seat"]
            if has(person, state.flights[flight].volunteers)
                return ["ERROR " + fields[2] + " already volunteered"]
            state.flights[flight].volunteers = state.flights[flight].volunteers.append(person)
            return ["VOLUNTEER " + fields[1] + " " + fields[2] + " " + seat_text(state, person)]
        if passenger.category == 2
            return ["ERROR infant " + fields[2] + " has no seat"]
        plane := state.aircraft[state.flights[flight].aircraft]
        seat := seat_id(plane, fields[3])
        if seat < 0 or plane.seats[seat].cabin != passenger.cabin
            return ["ERROR no seat " + fields[3] + " in cabin " + cabin_name(passenger.cabin)]
        if state.flights[flight].blocked[seat]
            return ["ERROR seat " + fields[3] + " is blocked"]
        if state.flights[flight].occupied[seat] >= 0
            return ["ERROR seat " + fields[3] + " is occupied"]
        if plane.seats[seat].exit_row and (passenger.category == 1 or with_infant(state, person))
            return ["ERROR exit row " + string(plane.seats[seat].row) + " not allowed for " + fields[2]]
        if not permitted(state, flight, person, seat, passenger.cabin, [person])
            return ["ERROR infant limit reached at " + fields[3]]
        old := seat_text(state, person)
        place(&state, person, seat)
        return ["MOVED " + fields[1] + " " + fields[2] + " " + old + " -> " + fields[3]].concat(reassign(&state, flight))
    flight := flight_id(state, fields[1])
    if flight < 0
        return ["ERROR unknown flight " + fields[1]]
    plane := state.aircraft[state.flights[flight].aircraft]
    modifying := command == "UPGRADE" or command == "CLOSE" or command == "BLOCK" or command == "UNBLOCK"
    if modifying and state.flights[flight].closed
        return [closed_error(state, flight)]
    if command == "BLOCK" or command == "UNBLOCK"
        seat := seat_id(plane, fields[2])
        if seat < 0
            return ["ERROR no seat " + fields[2] + " on " + fields[1]]
        blocking := command == "BLOCK"
        if state.flights[flight].blocked[seat] == blocking
            return ["ERROR seat " + fields[2] + (if blocking then " is blocked" else " is not blocked")]
        state.flights[flight].blocked[seat] = blocking
        output := [command + " " + fields[1] + " " + fields[2]]
        person := state.flights[flight].occupied[seat]
        if blocking and person >= 0
            place(&state, person, -1)
            place(&state, person, choose(state, flight, person, state.passengers[person].cabin))
            output = output.append("DISPLACED " + state.bookings[state.passengers[person].booking].pnr + " " + state.passengers[person].name + " " + fields[2] + " -> " + seat_text(state, person))
        return output.concat(reassign(&state, flight))
    if command == "UPGRADE"
        string[] output := []
        count := 0
        for: 1 <= pair_id < int(#plane.cabins)
            higher := plane.cabins[pair_id - 1].cabin
            lower := plane.cabins[pair_id].cabin
            int[] targets := []
            for: 0 <= tier < 3
                for person := people_of(state, flight)[]
                    passenger := state.passengers[person]
                    if passenger.cabin == lower and passenger.category == 0 and not with_infant(state, person) and tier_of(state, passenger.name) == tier
                        targets = targets.append(person)
            for person := targets[]
                if booked_count(state, flight, higher) >= state.flights[flight].limits[higher]
                    break
                seat := choose(state, flight, person, higher)
                if seat < 0
                    break
                passenger := state.passengers[person]
                old := seat_text(state, person)
                state.passengers[person].cabin = higher
                place(&state, person, seat)
                count += 1
                output = output.append("UPGRADED " + state.bookings[passenger.booking].pnr + " " + passenger.name + " " + cabin_name(lower) + " " + old + " -> " + cabin_name(higher) + " " + seat_text(state, person))
        return output.concat(reassign(&state, flight)).append("UPGRADE " + fields[1] + " " + string(count))
    if command == "CLOSE"
        string[] output := []
        for: 0 <= booking < int(#state.bookings)
            if state.bookings[booking].flight == flight and not state.bookings[booking].checked and remaining_count(state, booking) > 0
                output = output.append("NOSHOW " + state.bookings[booking].pnr + " " + string(remaining_count(state, booking)))
                for person := state.bookings[booking].people[]
                    remove_person(&state, person)
        output = output.concat(reassign(&state, flight))
        count := 0
        total := 0
        for section := plane.cabins[]
            int[] volunteers := []
            for person := state.flights[flight].volunteers[]
                if state.passengers[person].alive and state.passengers[person].seat >= 0 and state.passengers[person].cabin == section.cabin
                    volunteers = volunteers.append(person)
            for person := volunteers[]
                seat := state.passengers[person].seat
                useful := false
                for waiting := people_of(state, flight)[]
                    if state.passengers[waiting].category != 2 and state.passengers[waiting].seat < 0 and state.passengers[waiting].cabin == section.cabin
                        if permitted(state, flight, waiting, seat, section.cabin, [person])
                            useful = true
                            break
                if useful
                    compensation := [500, 300, 150][section.cabin]
                    output = output.append("DENIED VOLUNTARY " + state.bookings[state.passengers[person].booking].pnr + " " + state.passengers[person].name + " " + cabin_name(section.cabin) + " " + string(compensation))
                    remove_person(&state, person)
                    count += 1
                    total += compensation
                    output = output.concat(reassign(&state, flight))
        for person := people_of(state, flight)[]
            passenger := state.passengers[person]
            if passenger.alive and passenger.category != 2 and passenger.seat < 0
                compensation := [1000, 600, 300][passenger.cabin] / (if passenger.category == 1 then 2 else 1)
                output = output.append("DENIED INVOLUNTARY " + state.bookings[passenger.booking].pnr + " " + passenger.name + " " + cabin_name(passenger.cabin) + " " + string(compensation))
                remove_person(&state, person)
                count += 1
                total += compensation
        state.flights[flight].closed = true
        return output.append("CLOSED " + fields[1] + " denied " + string(count) + " compensation " + string(total))
    if command == "MAP"
        output := ["MAP " + fields[1]]
        for section := plane.cabins[]
            output = output.append("CABIN " + cabin_name(section.cabin)).append("   " + section.blocks.join(" "))
            for: section.first <= row <= section.last
                string[] blocks := []
                for: 0 <= block < int(#section.blocks)
                    text := ""
                    for seat := row_seats(plane, row, block)[]
                        text += if state.flights[flight].blocked[seat] then "#" elif state.flights[flight].occupied[seat] >= 0 then "X" elif plane.seats[seat].exit_row then "E" else "."
                    blocks = blocks.append(text)
                output = output.append((if row < 10 then " " else "") + string(row) + " " + blocks.join(" "))
        return output
    if command == "AVAIL"
        cabin := locate(fields[2], ["F", "J", "Y"])
        if cabin_id(plane, cabin) < 0
            return ["ERROR no cabin " + fields[2] + " on " + fields[1]]
        counts := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
        for: 0 <= seat < int(#plane.seats)
            if plane.seats[seat].cabin == cabin and not state.flights[flight].blocked[seat] and state.flights[flight].occupied[seat] < 0
                counts[0] += 1
                counts[1 + locate(plane.seats[seat].kind, ["W", "M", "A"])] += 1
                if plane.seats[seat].exit_row
                    counts[4] += 1
        return ["AVAIL " + fields[1] + " " + fields[2] + " free " + string(counts[0]) + " W " + string(counts[1]) + " M " + string(counts[2]) + " A " + string(counts[3]) + " EXIT " + string(counts[4])]
    if command == "LOADFACTOR"
        output := ["LOADFACTOR " + fields[1]]
        total_seats := 0
        total_seated := 0
        for section := plane.cabins[]
            seats := 0
            seated := 0
            for: 0 <= k < int(#plane.seats)
                if plane.seats[k].cabin == section.cabin
                    if not state.flights[flight].blocked[k]
                        seats += 1
                    if state.flights[flight].occupied[k] >= 0
                        seated += 1
            output = output.append(cabin_name(section.cabin) + " " + string(seated) + "/" + string(seats) + " " + load_factor(seated, seats) + " booked " + string(booked_count(state, flight, section.cabin)) + "/" + string(state.flights[flight].limits[section.cabin]))
            total_seats += seats
            total_seated += seated
        return output.append("ALL " + string(total_seated) + "/" + string(total_seats) + " " + load_factor(total_seated, total_seats))
    if command == "BALANCE"
        weight := 0
        moment := 0
        for person := people_of(state, flight)[]
            passenger := state.passengers[person]
            if passenger.seat >= 0
                amount := if passenger.category == 1 then 40 elif with_infant(state, person) then 90 else 80
                weight += amount
                moment += amount * (plane.seats[passenger.seat].row - plane.base)
        verdict := if moment < -plane.limit then "NOSE-HEAVY" elif moment > plane.limit then "TAIL-HEAVY" else "OK"
        return ["BALANCE " + fields[1] + " weight " + string(weight) + " moment " + string(moment) + " limit " + string(plane.limit) + " " + verdict]
    int[] seated_people := []
    int[] waiting_people := []
    infant_count := 0
    for: 0 <= seat < int(#plane.seats)
        if state.flights[flight].occupied[seat] >= 0
            seated_people = seated_people.append(state.flights[flight].occupied[seat])
    for person := people_of(state, flight)[]
        if state.passengers[person].category == 2
            infant_count += 1
        elif state.passengers[person].seat < 0
            waiting_people = waiting_people.append(person)
    if command == "MANIFEST"
        output := ["MANIFEST " + fields[1] + " seated " + string(#seated_people) + " unassigned " + string(#waiting_people) + " infants " + string(infant_count)]
        for person := seated_people.concat(waiting_people)[]
            passenger := state.passengers[person]
            booking := state.bookings[passenger.booking]
            result := (if passenger.seat < 0 then "---" else seat_text(state, person)) + " " + cabin_name(passenger.cabin) + " " + booking.pnr + " " + passenger.name + " " + ["ADULT", "CHILD"][passenger.category]
            if with_infant(state, person)
                result += " +" + state.passengers[passenger.partner].name
            tier := tier_of(state, passenger.name)
            if tier < 3
                result += " " + ["PLATINUM", "GOLD", "SILVER"][tier]
            if booking.checked
                result += " CHECKED"
            if has(person, state.flights[flight].volunteers)
                result += " VOL"
            output = output.append(result)
        return output
    int[][] keys := []
    string[] groups := []
    int[] order := []
    for: 0 <= k < int(#seated_people)
        person := seated_people[k]
        passenger := state.passengers[person]
        seat := plane.seats[passenger.seat]
        preboard := false
        for member := state.bookings[passenger.booking].people[]
            if state.passengers[member].alive and state.passengers[member].category == 2
                preboard = true
        group := if preboard then 0 elif passenger.cabin < 2 then 1 elif tier_of(state, passenger.name) < 2 then 2 else 3
        zone := (seat.row - plane.cabins[cabin_id(plane, 2)].first) / 5 + 1
        kind := locate(seat.kind, ["W", "M", "A"])
        key := [group, if group == 3 then -zone else 0, if group == 3 then kind else 0, if group == 3 then -seat.row else seat.row, passenger.seat]
        keys = keys.append(key)
        groups = groups.append(if group == 0 then "PRE" elif group == 1 then "CABIN" elif group == 2 then "TIER" else "ZONE" + string(zone))
        order = order.append(k)
        p := k
        while p > 0 and lex_before(key, keys[order[p - 1]])
            order[p] = order[p - 1]
            p -= 1
        order[p] = k
    output := ["BOARDING " + fields[1] + " " + string(#seated_people)]
    for: 0 <= k < int(#order)
        item := order[k]
        person := seated_people[item]
        passenger := state.passengers[person]
        output = output.append(string(k + 1) + " " + groups[item] + " " + seat_text(state, person) + " " + state.bookings[passenger.booking].pnr + " " + passenger.name)
    return output

    scan(&input_line)
